headline: On World Teachers' Day, UNESCO said AI should support teachers rather than replace them, as the world faces a shortage of 44 million secondary teachers by 2030.
score_reason: Matches pool score; annual-day messaging, no new policy.
importance_line: It affects students and teachers worldwide, but the piece is an explainer built on existing UNESCO and UNICEF figures.
summary: Education Times reports, citing UNESCO, that technology should support rather than replace teachers, noting a projected shortage of 44 million secondary teachers by 2030 and a UNICEF estimate of 6 million more educators when early childhood is included. The date also marks 60 years of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO teacher-status recommendation.
